name: postre-ordering-system
description: Postre Food Products - Messenger Ordering & Reservation System

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('public','dist/public',{recursive:true})" && node -e "const f=require('fs'),p=require('path');const src=p.resolve('data/uploads');const out=p.resolve('dist/data/uploads');let n=0;if(f.existsSync(src)){f.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});for(const file of f.readdirSync(src)){const ext=p.extname(file).toLowerCase();if(!['.jpg','.jpeg','.png','.webp','.gif'].includes(ext))continue;const to=p.join(out,file);if(!f.existsSync(to)){f.copyFileSync(p.join(src,file),to);n++;}}}console.log('uploads mirrored to dist/data/uploads: '+n+' new');"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const f=require('fs');const out='dist/data/uploads';f.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true});console.log('ensured '+out);try{f.mkdirSync('.git/hooks',{recursive:true});f.copyFileSync('.githooks/pre-push','.git/hooks/pre-push');f.chmodSync('.githooks/pre-push',0o755);console.log('installed git pre-push hook (auto db checkpoint)')}catch(e){console.log('skipping git hook install (CI/not a repo):',e.message)}"
scripts.seed: echo Seed disabled on the live system - it would add sample products/packages. See src/db/seed.ts.
